description: This file defines structures, function prototypes, and inline functions related to worker threads in the lighttpd server, including statistics, worker state, and connection management.

classes.name: liStatistics
classes.description: Structure holding various server and connection statistics such as bytes transferred, requests processed, active connections, and peak values.

classes.name: liWorkerTS
classes.description: Structure for worker timestamp data, including last generated time and string representation.

classes.name: liWorker
classes.description: Main structure representing a worker thread, including its state, connections, event loop, and associated data.

methods.name: li_worker_new
methods.description: Creates a new worker instance associated with a server and event loop.

methods.name: li_worker_free
methods.description: Frees the resources associated with a worker instance.

methods.name: li_worker_run
methods.description: Starts the worker thread's event loop.

methods.name: li_worker_stop
methods.description: Stops the worker, closing all connections and exiting the loop.

methods.name: li_worker_stopping
methods.description: Initiates stopping of the worker without immediately exiting the loop.

methods.name: li_worker_new_con
methods.description: Handles a new incoming connection for the worker.

methods.name: li_worker_current_timestamp
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp string for the worker.

methods.name: li_worker_add_closing_socket
methods.description: Shuts down a socket connection gracefully.

methods.name: li_cur_ts
methods.description: Inline function returning current timestamp for a worker.

methods.name: li_worker_from_iostream
methods.description: Inline function retrieving worker from an I/O stream.

methods.name: li_worker_from_stream
methods.description: Inline function retrieving worker from a stream.
